name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #ffffff offset to all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus states without visual clutter, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements. The trade-off is slightly larger focus rings, but they’re necessary for visibility on all backgrounds.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks colliding with adjacent elements in dense UIs, making it hard to distinguish focus. A 3px ring at 80% opacity on dark backgrounds or 2px at 90% on light ones meets WCAG 2.2 AA without bulk—test with Playwright MCP’s keyboard navigation checks to settle it.
